home.heroTitle: Spare parts & service for intelligent lifting devices
home.heroSubtitle: WiMa and SAS operate the complete European spare parts warehouse for G-Force and Easy Arm systems – with expertise that matters on the shop floor.
home.feature1Text: Complete spare parts stock in Germany – short lead times and fast availability.
home.feature2Text: From Vi/ViPlus through Q2/iQ2 to legacy Q/iQ – we know the installed base in Europe.
home.feature3Text: Identify parts visually, select them, and start a service or quote request immediately.
home.feature4Text: WiMa in Wetter and SAS in Hohndorf – service and warehouse competence combined.

about.title: About us
about.subtitle: Two companies. One European service and spare parts competence.
about.intro: WiMa Industrie-Automation GmbH and SAS Sauer-Automation Sachsen jointly operate the European spare parts warehouse and qualified service for intelligent lifting devices of the G-Force and Easy Arm family.
about.wimaText: WiMa stands for industrial automation and practical systems competence. From Wetter we provide technical know-how and customer support for the Western European market.
about.sasText: SAS runs the European spare parts warehouse and supports service operations with fast parts availability. Hohndorf is our logistics backbone for all of Europe.
about.competence1: Spare part identification and supply capability
about.competence4: Service requests with product context from the configurator
about.independenceText: We are an independent service and spare parts provider. This website does not use official manufacturer logos or brand presentations – we offer expert support and parts for the installed base in Europe.
